title: FLAKE: disappearing_server test case is flaky on multiple platforms

labels.name: disposition/BUILDNURSE
labels.description: For all buildnurse related build/test failures and flakes

body:
Currently this is one of the top test flakes on bazel RBE.
- flaky both on linux and windows (on linux mostly epoll1 is affected)
- flaky across multiple flavors of the same test (h2_http_proxy_nosec_test, h2_proxy_nosec_test, h2_http_proxy_test, h2_spiffe_test, h2_http_proxy_nosec_test)
- because of many flavors of the test are flaky, the flakiness adds up and we see a lot of red
